analyzed_vuln.description: Heap-use-after-free caused by reusing a temporary SkGlyphRun whose internal SkPaint has already been destroyed. In SkCanvas::onDrawText(), inside the LOOPER iteration, fScratchGlyphRunBuilder->drawText() rebuilds fScratchGlyphRun and then iter.fDevice->drawGlyphRun(looper.paint(), glyphRun) is called. During drawGlyphRun on GPU path, SkGlyphRun::temporaryShuntToDrawPosText() uses glyphRun->fRunPaint (copied from looper.paint()). But on the next loop iteration, SkGlyphRunBuilder::initialize() explicitly calls fScratchGlyphRun.~SkGlyphRun(), freeing that SkPaint’s refcounted members (including SkColorFilter). Later GPU text code (GrTextUtils::Paint::initFilteredColor -> fPaint->getColorFilter()->filterColor4f) dereferences the stale color filter pointer, producing UAF.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered by api_mock_gpu_canvas text drawing path with a paint that includes a color filter (from fuzz_paint/make_fuzz_colorfilter) and a draw-looper/multi-iteration LOOPER path in SkCanvas::onDrawText. Dataflow: fuzz_canvas() -> SkCanvas::drawText/onDrawText -> loop calls SkGlyphRunBuilder::drawText + drawGlyphRun; destruction/reinitialization of scratch glyph run between iterations invalidates run paint state while GPU drawPosText path still uses it, leading to UAF read in SkColorFilter::filterColor4f.
